items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: The transcript contains no mention of Bill Basie by the interviewee. The name appears only in the interviewer's question.

ctx.x: We usually clear them out much faster than that. Well anyway, you were asking about Bill Basie and Joe Williams? Which I’ve known Joe Williams so long that I don’t remember where I met him. I can’t pin it down. I was trying to think, I knew of course a couple of days ago I would be talking to you and I was trying to think well where did you meet Joe Williams. It’s been so long ago. He was just there all of a sudden.
He was a Chicago guy, I don’t know—

items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: In fact that’s where I first saw him was with Count Basie and then I met him later when we worked with him on the show.

ctx.x: He was a Chicago guy, I don’t know—
Did you know him before Basie?
